The 2025 Jura presidential elections was held on December 17, 2025, and December 18, 2025, for elected the authorities of Republic and Canton of Jura for the 2026 presidential year. The terms of office begin on January 1, 2026, and end on December 31, 2026. Is the first presidential election after the 2025 Jura cantonal election
The president and the vice president of the government are elected by the Parliament based on seniority between ministers.
The president of Parliament is also elected by the assembly.
Result
The president and the vice president were elected with 100% of the valid ballots. There were 6 and 4 blank votes..
The president of Parliament of Jura was elected by 50 votes and 3 votes were cast for other candidates.
